items.author: techskills
items.limits: Image accessibility descriptions can be imperfect; slide9 exposed no substantive text. No underlying software price or performance was verified from social content.
items.summary: Carousel presents ten software alternatives as challenges to paid products. Readable slides mention yt-dlp, Ollama, Fooocus, Whisper, Plausible, AppFlowy, Penpot, n8n and Bitwarden.

claims.claim: Open/free software can replace paid alternatives
claims.finding: Official pages distinguish self-hosted community editions from paid managed/enterprise offerings and applicable license terms. This does not establish zero hosting/operations costs or equivalent features.

claims.claim: These alternatives are replacing billion-dollar businesses
claims.finding: No measured adoption, issuer revenue impact, margins, valuation or causal market-performance evidence supplied.

asset_resolution.reason: Named products are not exact supported catalog asset identities; competitive exposure cannot justify automatic ticker substitution.
